responsibility: This definition module declares a tiny runtime debugging aid for attaching gdb to a running GNU Modula-2 program. It belongs to the diagnostic/support layer and exports sleepSpin, finishSpin, and connectSpin so code can deliberately pause, wait for a debugger to attach, and provide a stable breakpoint location before execution continues.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the API declaration for the gdbif pair, exporting the debugger-control entry points sleepSpin, finishSpin, and connectSpin; gdbif.mod provides the waiting loop, printed attach instructions, and helper-file behavior behind that interface.
